description:
`rand_chacha` and `rand_core` 0.9 are declared once in `[workspace.dependencies]`, with `gf2-sim` — the one workspace member consuming them today — inheriting that declaration, so the campaign's random-number source has one version the workspace agrees on.

## Background

A published sampling dataset must let any shard be regenerated from its address alone, so the random-matrix source has to be version-stable; a version that drifts per crate is how a dataset silently stops being regenerable. Three `rand_chacha` majors and two `rand` majors coexist today: the workspace declares `rand = "0.8"` and no `rand_chacha` at all (`Cargo.toml:27`); `gf2-sim` pins `rand_chacha = "0.9"` with `rand = "0.9"` directly (`crates/gf2-sim/Cargo.toml:18-19`); `gf2-kernels-hip` pins the same pair as development dependencies (`crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml:33-34`); `gf2-coding` pins an optional `rand_chacha = "0.3"` (`crates/gf2-coding/Cargo.toml:23`), which belongs to the `rand` 0.8 ecosystem; and `gf2-core` uses the workspace `rand = "0.8"`. `@/inv/convention-convergence` requires a shared convention to have one form; this change is where that convergence happens for the 0.9 ecosystem.

One constraint shapes how far the convergence reaches: `gf2-kernels-hip` is excluded from the workspace (`Cargo.toml`, `exclude`) because it needs ROCm to build, so it has no workspace parent to inherit from and cannot use `workspace = true`; it follows the same versions by explicit pin.

The `gf2-coding` holdout is recorded as a named exception by its own documentation leaf behind this one; nothing in this change migrates the 0.8 ecosystem.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `rand_chacha` and `rand_core` are declared once in `[workspace.dependencies]` at version 0.9, and `gf2-sim` — the one workspace member consuming them today — consumes them through `workspace = true`, its direct pins replaced in this change.
- [hard] REQ-02: `gf2-kernels-hip`, which the workspace excludes because it requires ROCm to build and which therefore cannot inherit workspace dependencies, pins the same 0.9 versions explicitly, with a comment naming the exclusion as the reason it cannot inherit.
- [hard] REQ-03: The workspace builds and its tests pass with no crate resolving two `rand_chacha` 0.9 copies, verifiable from the lockfile.

## Notes

Scope is the version migration alone: no new crate, no sampler code, and no exception documentation land here.
title: Workspace convergence of the rand 0.9 ecosystem
